# Swagat Public School, Lakhna (SPS Lakhna)

> Swagat Public School (also written SPS Lakhna) is a kindergarten and primary school in Lakhna, Nuapada district, Odisha, India, established in 2024. It teaches children from Nursery to Class 5 in a caring, activity-based environment. "Swagat" means "welcome", and the school's motto is "Where Every Child is Welcome".

## Key facts
- **Name:** Swagat Public School
- **Also known as:** SPS Lakhna, Swagat Public School Lakhna
- **Established:** 2024
- **Type:** Kindergarten and primary school (co-educational)
- **Classes:** Nursery, LKG, UKG, Class 1 to Class 5
- **Location:** Lakhna, Nuapada district, Odisha 766105, India
- **Areas served:** Lakhna and nearby parts of Nuapada district, including Nuapada, Khariar Road, Komna and Khariar
- **Website:** https://spslakhna.in
- **Phone and WhatsApp:** +91 84579 69611 (https://wa.me/918457969611)
- **Email:** swagatlakhna24@gmail.com
- **Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Closed on Sundays.
- **Logo:** https://spslakhna.in/images/sps-seal.svg (a gold lotus rising from an open book on a purple seal)

## Academic programs
- **Early Years (Nursery, LKG, UKG):** Ages 3 to 6. Play-based learning, sensory development, basic phonics and numeracy, and social skills. Classes finish at 12:00 PM.
- **Primary Years (Class 1 to 5):** Ages 6 to 11. Mathematics, Science, English, EVS and computer fundamentals, with physical education and independent learning skills. Classes finish at 2:00 PM.

## What the school offers
- Small class sizes with a 1:15 teacher-to-student ratio
- Play-based, hands-on curriculum in the early years
- Art, music, movement and storytelling alongside academics
- Safe, child-friendly classrooms

## Admissions
Admissions are open for Nursery to Class 5. Parents fill in the application form at https://spslakhna.in/admissions (it is sent to the school office on WhatsApp), visit the school to meet the teachers, and then receive confirmation of enrolment. Nursery admission is for children aged 3 to 4 years, LKG 4 to 5, UKG 5 to 6.
